name: toast-pos-mcp
description: Local, read-only Toast POS reporting tools for Claude Code. Public preview; operator authorization, Merchant consent, and Toast requirements remain the operator's responsibility.

toast_api_hostname.title: Toast API hostname
toast_api_hostname.description: Bare Toast Standard API hostname, with no scheme, path, query, or port.

toast_client_id.title: Toast client ID
toast_client_id.description: Operator-owned Toast Standard API client ID. Stored as a sensitive plugin value.

toast_client_secret.title: Toast client secret
toast_client_secret.description: Operator-owned Toast Standard API client secret. Stored as a sensitive plugin value.

toast_default_restaurant_guid.title: Default restaurant GUID
toast_default_restaurant_guid.description: An authorized Toast restaurant GUID used to bootstrap the selected-location context.

merchant_ai_consent_acknowledged.title: Merchant AI-processing consent is documented
merchant_ai_consent_acknowledged.description: Set true only after documented Merchant consent and applicable Toast/provider requirements are satisfied. This acknowledgment is not legal proof.
